verdict.rationale: Galileo documents official SDKs: a first-party Python SDK (the rungalileo/galileo-python repo with an `@log` decorator) and a quickstart that runs in either Python or TypeScript. SDK-based instrumentation such as the GalileoSpanProcessor is also documented. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK API reference evidence (especially for TypeScript), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Thanks to Galileo's Python SDK we'll be able to check the application's performance and tool selection.
You can also use the `@log` decorator to log spans.
This guide works with Python or TypeScript, using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI service, Anthropic, or Gemini LLMs.
Stitch traces across two agents in different processes using OTel and the GalileoSpanProcessor.
